The '''Dakaret system''' was located in the [[Oktos sector/Legends|Oktos sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Holovid/Legends|holo-vid]] ''[[Denizens of Dakaret IX]]''.<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Dakaret [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-12.<ref name="TEA" />
